# What is your workers' comp experience mod, and which claims are costing you?

> Free workers' comp experience mod (x-mod) calculator for contractors and small employers: estimate your mod from your rating worksheet and claims, see the premium impact and what each claim costs over three years. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/experience-mod-calculator/)
